_comment: MATLAB-produced reference metrics for the level-2 parity CI gate. Regenerate with code/python/tests/reference/runPhase5Metrics.m (see tests/reference/README.md). Recorded from MATLAB R2024b + RAVEN 2.11.2 on the committed yeast-GEM.xml of the source commit below. Both R2 values are the coefficient of determination about the line of identity over all data points, matching code/modelTests/{growth,anaerobic_flux_predictions}.m since 'fix: report CoD as R2 and not Pearson's r'.

tolerances._rationale: Two independent sources of drift. (1) R^2 metrics differ at ~1e-4 between solvers; this is genuine solver drift. (2) The essential-gene confusion matrix differs from the MATLAB reference by one gene (Python 933/65/94/15 vs MATLAB 934/65/94/14). That one is NOT solver drift: it is unchanged when Python also uses Gurobi, so it reflects a difference between cobrapy's single_gene_deletion and RAVEN's findGeneDeletions around the 1e-6 growth-ratio threshold, not the LP solver. gene_count_abs absorbs it pending investigation.
